name: Acmer S2 Pro 48W
tagline: Top Acmer S2 Pro — 48W compressed diode with bundle options
tldr: Acmer S2 Pro 48W is Acmer's high-power open-frame option before the enclosed P3. Strong cutting claims — verify optical power and compare to P3 48W enclosed if you need smoke control.
mainObjective: Maximum cut speed and depth in the line — engraving remains strong at tuned speeds

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Top Acmer S2 Pro — 48W compressed diode with bundle options
Open-frame layout — laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Work area 400 × 400 mm on this chassis
Best cut headroom in the line — benchmarked around 10 mm basswood-class stock
48W: the most cut-focused head in the Acmer S2 Pro line
Reference engrave job on this module: ~12–18 min
cons: Ultra-fine photo engraving may need slower settings than a 10W engraving-first module
Still a diode — clear acrylic production wants CO₂
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 48W module on Acmer S2 Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Treat engraving and cutting as separate profiles. Push cut speeds only after test squares on your material. Compare CO₂ only when clear acrylic or all-day production enters the picture.
